"""Frozen cohort: fn_80077D40 typed item indexing instead of a byte-offset carrier.

Evidence: retail keeps offset (r31, +0x10) and index (r30) as separate induction
variables and forms item = items + offset, MWCC's strength reduction of &items[i].
The earlier removal-only probe (plain u32 offset) differs by 6 words.
Stopping condition: control + four fixed variants once; actual profile; no search.
"""
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import api, fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project
p = Project('GFZE01'); out = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/texlist-index'); e = fixup.Engine(p, out)
key = 'main:fn_80077D40'; s = p.resolve(key); mw, flags = oracle.version_for(p, s)
src = p.unit_record(p.unit_of(s))['source']
body = api._canonical_text(p, src)
decl = '    u32 i;\n    struct { u32 value; } offset;\n    u32 total;\n'
init = '    total = 0;\n    i = 0;\n    offset.value = 0;\n\n    while (i < arg0->count) {\n        item = (struct Item *)((u8 *)arg0->items + offset.value);\n'
step = '        offset.value += sizeof(struct Item);\n        i++;\n    }\n'
assert decl in body and init in body and step in body
rows = [e.record(key, body, mw, flags, label='installed control')]
def add(text, label):
    assert text != body
    rows.append(e.record(key, text, mw, flags, parent=rows[0]['id'], label=label))
w = body.replace(decl, '    u32 i;\n    u32 total;\n').replace(init, '    total = 0;\n    i = 0;\n\n    while (i < arg0->count) {\n        item = &arg0->items[i];\n').replace(step, '        i++;\n    }\n')
add(w, 'typed index; while loop')
f = body.replace(decl, '    u32 i;\n    u32 total;\n').replace(init, '    total = 0;\n\n    for (i = 0; i < arg0->count; i++) {\n        item = &arg0->items[i];\n').replace(step, '    }\n')
add(f, 'typed index; for loop')
add(w.replace('        item = &arg0->items[i];\n', '        item = arg0->items + i;\n'), 'pointer-plus index; while loop')
add(f.replace('    total = 0;\n\n    for', '    for').replace('    u32 total;\n', '    u32 total = 0;\n'), 'typed index; for loop; initialized total')
with oracle.build_lock(): e.evaluate(rows)
report = dict(hypothesis=__doc__.strip(), stopping_condition='control + four fixed variants once', records=rows, best={},
              frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows}, generator_sha256=e.generator_sha256, environment=e.environment)
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n'); fixup.archive_sources(report, out / 'sources.json.gz')
for r in rows: print(r['sha256'][:12], bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors'), r.get('extra_helpers'), r['label'])

"""Follow-up: natural spellings of the LOD sentinel tests on the typed for-loop form.

Retail `addis r0,r7,1; cmplwi r0,0xffff` is MWCC's lowering of an unsigned compare
with 0xFFFFFFFF; `lhz; cmpwi -1` is an int-promoted u16 compare with -1.
Stopping condition: three fixed variants once; actual profile; no search.
"""
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project
p = Project('GFZE01'); out = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/texlist-index'); e = fixup.Engine(p, out)
prev = json.loads((out / 'report.json').read_text())
parent = next(r for r in prev['records'] if r['label'] == 'typed index; for loop')
key = 'main:fn_80077D40'; mw, flags = parent['mw'], parent['flags']
base = Path(parent['source']).read_text()
a_old = '            if ((max_lod + 0x10000) == 0xFFFF) {\n'
b_old = '            if ((s32)item->max_lod != -1 && item->max_lod < max_lod) {\n'
assert a_old in base and b_old in base
a = base.replace(a_old, '            if (max_lod == 0xFFFFFFFF) {\n')
b = base.replace(b_old, '            if (item->max_lod != -1 && item->max_lod < max_lod) {\n')
ab = a.replace(b_old, '            if (item->max_lod != -1 && item->max_lod < max_lod) {\n')
rows = [e.record(key, t, mw, flags, parent=parent['id'], label=l) for t, l in
        [(a, 'unsigned all-ones LOD sentinel'), (b, 'promoted u16 sentinel without cast'), (ab, 'both natural sentinel tests')]]
with oracle.build_lock(): e.evaluate(rows)
prev['records'] += rows; prev['frontier']['all_frozen_probes'] += rows
prev['hypothesis'] += '\n\n' + __doc__.strip()
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(prev, indent=2) + '\n'); fixup.archive_sources(prev, out / 'sources.json.gz')

"""snapshot: save canonical text of every ranking.c unit. eval LABEL: compile changed units."""
import sys, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import api, fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project

mode = sys.argv[1]
snap = Path(sys.argv[2])
p = Project('GFZE01')
units = [u for u in p.load_units() if u.get('tu') == 'rel/main_rel/ranking.c']
texts = {}
for u in units:
    texts[u['symbols'][0]] = api._canonical_text(p, u['source'])
if mode == 'snapshot':
    snap.write_text(json.dumps(texts))
    print(len(texts), 'units')
    raise SystemExit
before = json.loads(snap.read_text())
label = sys.argv[3]
out = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/ranking-archive') / label
e = fixup.Engine(p, out)
rows = []
for name, text in texts.items():
    if before.get(name) == text:
        continue
    key = 'main_rel:' + name
    mw, flags = oracle.version_for(p, p.resolve(key))
    rows.append(e.record(key, text, mw, flags, label=label, before_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before[name].encode()).hexdigest()))
with oracle.build_lock():
    e.evaluate(rows)
report = dict(hypothesis='Shared RankingArchive layout for lbl_1_data_4C810[4]; installed-form compile of every changed ranking.c unit.',
              stopping_condition='fixed loop/prototype variants once', records=rows, best={},
              frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows}, generator_sha256=e.generator_sha256, environment=e.environment)
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
fixup.archive_sources(report, out / 'sources.json.gz')
for r in rows:
    print(r['symbol'], r['sha256'][:12], bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors'), r.get('extra_helpers'))

"""Archive typed-index cohorts and write state/repairs/typed-index-recovery-20261116.json.

stage 'archive': write the two replay archives. stage 'manifest': needs replay outputs + gate log.
"""
import sys, json, gzip, hashlib, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import fixup

S = Path(sys.argv[2])
stage = sys.argv[1]
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
R = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review')
A_DIRS = [R / 'texlist-index', R / 'graph-index', R / 'ranking-index']
B_DIRS = [R / 'ranking-archive/final', R / 'ranking-archive/fn_1_159478', R / 'ranking-archive/prototype']
A = Path('state/repairs/typed-index-probes-20261116.sources.json.gz')
B = Path('state/repairs/ranking-archive-layout-20261116.sources.json.gz')

def combined(dirs):
    reps = [json.loads((d / 'report.json').read_text()) for d in dirs]
    assert len({r['generator_sha256'] for r in reps}) == 1
    rows = [x for r in reps for x in r['records']]
    return dict(hypothesis='\n\n'.join(r['hypothesis'] for r in reps), records=rows, best={},
                frontier={'all_frozen_probes': rows}, generator_sha256=reps[0]['generator_sha256'],
                environment=reps[0]['environment'], environments=sorted({r['environment'] for r in reps})), reps

if stage == 'archive':
    for dirs, path in ((A_DIRS, A), (B_DIRS, B)):
        rep, _ = combined(dirs)
        fixup.archive_sources(rep, path)
        print(path, len(json.loads(gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()))['records']))
    raise SystemExit

def summary(rows):
    return [dict(symbol=x['symbol'], label=x['label'], sha256=x['sha256'], mw=x['mw'], flags=x['flags'],
                 matched=bool(x.get('matched')), word_errors=x.get('word_errors'),
                 object_matched=x.get('object_matched'), extra_helpers=x.get('extra_helpers')) for x in rows]

def multiset(rows):
    return sorted((r['symbol'], r['sha256'], r['mw'], r['flags'], bool(r.get('matched')), r.get('word_errors')) for r in rows)

replays = {}
for path in (A, B):
    arch = json.loads(gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()))
    rep = json.loads(Path(f'.fzgx/fixup/replay/{path.name}/replay.json').read_text())
    assert rep['reproduced'] == len(arch['records']) and multiset(arch['records']) == multiset(rep['records']), path
    profiles = {(r['symbol'], r['sha256']): r['compile_profile'] for r in arch['records']}
    assert all(profiles[(r['symbol'], r['sha256'])] == r['compile_profile'] for r in rep['records'])
    replays[path.name] = dict(sha256=sha(path.read_bytes()), records=len(arch['records']), replayed=rep['reproduced'])

log = Path('.fzgx/manual-device-review/ranking-archive/full-gates.log').read_bytes()
text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', log.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
returns = re.findall(r'^RETURN (\d+)$', text, re.M)
assert returns == ['0'] * 4 and text.count('16 files OK') >= 2 and '0 finding(s)' in text
census_path = Path('state/repairs/device-census-typed-index-20261116.json.gz')
census = json.loads(gzip.decompress(census_path.read_bytes()))
regen = json.loads((S / 'regen.json').read_text())
head = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
cohorts = {}
for d in A_DIRS + B_DIRS + [R / 'ranking-archive/index-stale', R / 'ranking-archive/controls']:
    r = json.loads((d / 'report.json').read_text())
    cohorts[str(d.relative_to(R))] = dict(hypothesis=r['hypothesis'], stopping_condition=r['stopping_condition'],
                                         environment=r['environment'], records=summary(r['records']))
final = json.loads((R / 'ranking-archive/final/report.json').read_text())['records']
scripts = {n: dict(sha256=sha((S / n).read_bytes()), text=(S / n).read_text()) for n in (
    'texlist_probe.py', 'texlist_probe2.py', 'graph_probe.py', 'ranking_probe.py', 'ranking_probe2.py',
    'ranking_apply.py', 'ranking_eval.py', 'ranking_478.py', 'ranking_1577.py', 'ranking_proto.py', 'typed_manifest.py')}
installed_texlist = next(x for x in json.loads((R / 'texlist-index/report.json').read_text())['records']
                         if x['label'] == 'both natural sentinel tests')
manifest = dict(
    format='fzgx-device-cleanup-provenance-v1', version='GFZE01', base_commit=head,
    source_tree_sha256=census['source_tree_sha256'], configuration_sha256=census['configuration_sha256'],
    headers={h: sha(Path(h).read_bytes()) for h in ('include/rel/main_rel/ranking.h', 'include/rel/main_rel/ranking_archive.h')},
    sources={s_: sha(Path(s_).read_bytes()) for s_ in ('src/dol/fn_80077D40.c', 'src/rel/main_rel/ranking.c')},
    evidence=dict(
        strength_reduction='Retail keeps a byte offset and an index as separate induction registers; this is MWCC strength reduction of &array[i].',
        ranking_layout='lbl_1_data_4C810 is 0xF0 = 4 x 0x3C; data relocations place an archive path string and a u16 id table at +0/+4 of entries 1..3; six functions index the same fields.',
        sentinel='addis r0,r7,1; cmplwi r0,0xffff lowers an unsigned compare with 0xFFFFFFFF; lhz; cmpwi -1 is the int-promoted u16 compare with -1.'),
    cohorts=cohorts, scripts=scripts, replay_archives=replays,
    replay_commands=['python tools/fzgx.py fixup --archive state/repairs/' + A.name,
                     'python tools/fzgx.py fixup --archive state/repairs/' + B.name],
    accepted=[dict(function='main:fn_80077D40', sha256=installed_texlist['sha256'], label=installed_texlist['label'])] +
             [dict(function='main_rel:' + x['symbol'], sha256=x['sha256'], matched=bool(x.get('matched')),
                   object_matched=x.get('object_matched'), extra_helpers=x.get('extra_helpers')) for x in final],
    removed=dict(scalar_carriers=2, private_layout_views=5, generated_aggregate_views=1, byte_stride_offsets=2,
                 tagged_register_copy_blocks=0),
    negative=dict(function='main_rel:fn_1_10A8D0', word_errors=sorted({x.get('word_errors') for x in cohorts['graph-index']['records'] if not x['matched']})),
    pre_existing=dict(function='main_rel:fn_1_1577D0', note='Object matches exactly; extra-helper source-policy flag is identical in the committed control.'),
    data_import_regeneration=regen,
    partial_cleanups_only=True, new_fully_natural_function_credit=0, fully_natural_function_credit_claimed=False,
    census=dict(path=census_path.name, sha256=sha(census_path.read_bytes()), categories=census['categories'],
                known_scaffolding_owner_function_union=len(census['confirmed_debt_owner_functions'])),
    validation=dict(commands=['.venv/bin/python configure.py', 'ninja -j 2 build/GFZE01/ok',
                              'build/tools/dtk shasum -q -c config/GFZE01/build.sha1', '.venv/bin/python tools/fzgx.py lint'],
                    returns=[int(x) for x in returns], linked_hashes=16, independent_hashes=16, lint_findings=0, local_log_sha256=sha(log)),
    limits='Only fields used by the six functions are named; words 0x30..0x38 keep observed roles. The data unit keeps its raw-word '
           'definition and own header. Removing carriers does not certify these functions device-free.',
)
Path('state/repairs/typed-index-recovery-20261116.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print('ok', {k: v['records'] for k, v in replays.items()}, manifest['census']['categories']['single-field-value-carrier-review'])
